in_sanskrit.name: शर्विका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्विका (sharvikā) is a Sanskrit name derived from the word शर्वती (śarvatī), meaning Goddess Saraswati. The name Sharvika signifies the grace of the Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, learning, and art. In Hindu mythology, Saraswati is often depicted holding a veena, a musical instrument, symbolizing the harmony and rhythm of the universe.
